clean_state_policy.cache_policy: disable or clear declared Python/implementation caches before each fixture
clean_state_policy.clean_state_definition: fresh process, empty fixture directory except declared inputs, cleared declared variables, deterministic seed, no files/process state carried from an earlier fixture

dependency_lock.name: external-packages
dependency_lock.policy: none; Stage 5 candidate implementations use standard library unless a Lead-approved disposition changes this

elapsed_time_capture: monotonic wall-clock milliseconds including process spawn and teardown
newline_policy: capture raw bytes; canonical expected text uses LF

snapshot_serializer.file_state_rule: record declared file path, mode, pointer/record boundary and cleanup/error result only inside isolated fixture directory
snapshot_serializer.logical_mode: compare abstract logical items/live range, return value, flags, output and declared side effects
snapshot_serializer.physical_mode: also compare backing storage, unused slots and pointer/index representation when source contract exposes them or fixture requests representation check
snapshot_serializer.preservation_rule: compare required pre-state and post-failure snapshot field by field; hand inspection is not evidence
snapshot_serializer.two_stack_rule: serialize each stack independently and include both success flags and returned results in the same snapshot

transform_rules.allowed_when: fixture oracle explicitly declares line-ending agnostic output

termination_policy.timeout_action: request controlled termination, then kill after grace period

working_directory_policy.path_policy: relative fixture paths only; no machine-specific absolute paths in artifacts
working_directory_policy.root: fresh temporary directory created per fixture
working_directory_policy.source_policy: read-only source and fixture inputs; no writes beside declared output directory
